question: What preparatory acts must precede the main offerings in this worship sequence?
premises: Invocation and worship with fragrances and other items are prescribed.
These acts are to be performed in sequence.
The sequence begins with the joining of channels.
inference: Therefore the worshipper must first invoke and worship with fragrances and other offerings, beginning with the joining of channels.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of nāḍī-sandhāna in this ritual context is not fully explicit.
